nodes.label: tier4MultiWordQuery
nodes.description: GIN trigram on street_lc + locality_lc per-word. GREATEST similarity per word. LIMIT 8000 subquery then DISTINCT ON.

nodes.label: tierPostcodeQuery
nodes.description: btree (postcode text_pattern_ops) — <1ms. Exact equality for 4-digit, LIKE prefix for 2-3 digit.
